name: Mein Schiff 4
line: A Private Terrace At The Top
lede: The Himmel & Meer loft suites sit on the top deck of TUI Cruises’ Mein Schiff 4, each with its own terrace. As part of an upgrade, Platinum Electric Marine heaters let guests sit out whenever the air turns cool.
data: Himmel & Meer loft suites – private terraces
beats: Loft suites on the top deck, each opening onto its own private terrace with a view of the sea.
Guests wanted to use their terraces in the cool air of northern itineraries.
Platinum Smart-Heat Electric Marine heaters were fitted to the suite terraces as part of an upgrade in 2019.
